site-feeds 1.0.2 changelog

- Add instruction to include source links [topic](url) for each topic when presenting to users via channels that support Markdown.
- Documentation, commands, and usage remain unchanged.

- Added subscription management commands: unsubscribe (delete group) and remove-subscription (remove path from group).
- Updated documentation to include new subscription workflows and command examples.
- No changes to code were detected; documentation only.

Initial release of the site-feeds skill.

- Enables fetching the latest content and updates from sites like YouTube, GitHub, Instagram, Reddit, blogs, and news platforms.
- Provides detailed usage documentation for the airsstool CLI, covering installation, feed discovery, content fetching, and subscription management.
- Supports fuzzy searching, filtering, and multiple output formats for fetched content.
- Allows setup and management of custom feed subscriptions, with persistence via SQLite database.
- Offers step-by-step installation guidance, including optional local RSSHub deployment.
